name: Blue Grants Fund

funder.name: Seychelles Conservation and Climate Adaptation Trust (SeyCCAT)

summary: Annual grant round for Seychellois-led projects in marine conservation, habitat rehabilitation, sustainable fisheries and blue-economy work, with small, medium and large grant sizes. Overseas-based applicants are not eligible.

amount.note: Small grants up to SCR 100,000, medium up to 1 million, large up to 2 million

steps: Concept note with logframe, itemised budget and Gantt chart
Full project proposal, if invited (medium and large grants)

eligibility.rule: NGOs and businesses are registered in Seychelles for at least 1 year; businesses are majority Seychellois-owned
For large grants, be an NGO or governmental entity with large-project experience and formal accounting systems

calls.label: Annual Blue Grants Fund call
calls.recurring: Opens each April for a six-week application window

status.quote: Important Note: Applications are currently closed.

recurring.quote: Every year in April, SeyCCAT opens a 6-week application window for the submission of project proposals under the Blue Grants Fund.

applicant_types.quote: ALL CITIZENS OF SEYCHELLES GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENT / AGENCIES PARASTATAL ORGANISATION LOCALLY-REGISTERED NGOS (MUST BE REGISTERED FOR AT LEAST 1 YEAR) BUSINESSES WITH MAJORITY SEYCHELLOIS OWNERSHIP

geography.quote: The Blue Grants Fund (BGF) provides funding to innovative Seychellois-led projects that advance marine conservation, sustainable fisheries, and other key areas within the blue economy sector.

access.quote: Every year in April, SeyCCAT opens a 6-week application window for the submission of project proposals under the Blue Grants Fund.

window.quote: Every year in April, SeyCCAT opens a 6-week application window for the submission of project proposals under the Blue Grants Fund.

amount.quote: Our grant sizes are small up to (SCR 100,000), medium (up to 1 Million) and large (up to 2 Million).

co_finance_required.quote: Co-financing is not needed for small grants (but may be indicated) and is encouraged for medium and large grants.

effort.quote: Applicants must prepare a concept note, a logframe, a gantt chart, and an itemised budget.
If successful, applicants for medium and large grants will be invited to stage 2, where they need to submit a full project proposal.

eligibility.quote: LOCALLY-REGISTERED NGOS (MUST BE REGISTERED FOR AT LEAST 1 YEAR) BUSINESSES WITH MAJORITY SEYCHELLOIS OWNERSHIP (MUST BE REGISTERD FOR AT LEAST 1 YEAR)
The large grants are available only to NGOs and governmental entities with a proven track record of managing large projects and formal financial accounting systems.

after_award.quote: Sites visit to assess project implementation

documents.quote: concept note, logframe, budget and gantt chart
Applicants must prepare a concept note, a logframe, a gantt chart, and an itemised budget.
Other project-relevant documents, including CVs and company profiles, are to be submitted as well.
